notes: Payer mix and reimbursement are from general knowledge, not the website evidence.

healthcare_provider_setting.value: Home-based care provider: personal care, home health and hospice services

clinical_specialty.value: Home care for elderly, disabled and chronically ill: personal care, skilled home health, hospice

patient_activity_volume.value: Personal care to a large base of patients; home health and hospice to a much smaller patient base

payer_revenue_mix.value: Predominantly state Medicaid and other government programs for personal care; smaller Medicare, managed care and private pay shares

payment_reimbursement_model.value: Government contracts and fee-for-service hourly rates for personal care; Medicare episodic/per-diem payment for home health and hospice

setting_specific_capacity.value: Multiple branch offices across about two dozen states

patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Elderly, disabled and chronically ill patients at risk of hospitalization; mostly non-medical personal care, plus skilled and hospice care
